newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Chiao Tung Bank soars on debut.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Chiao Tung Bank soars on debut.

text.p: Taiwan's Chiao Tung Bank soared to the daily seven percent limit on its debut in early trade on Wednesday.
After 60 minutes, the firm, topping the gainers' list, was limit up, surging T$4 to T$58.50 on the Taiwan Stock Exchange.
"Chiao Tung Bank has strong fundamentals, so it should be able to enjoy three to four days of a honeymoon rally," said Albert Lin of Golden Securities.
Brokers said the market had expected the listing of Chiao Tung Bank to lead the performance of the heavily weighted financial sector and the main market.
